tldr: 台股收漲 0.65% 至 45,224.29 點，台積電領軍、三大法人買超 320.5 億元站回季線，逆勢消化美股利空。
台日深化「民主」半導體供應鏈合作、日月光加碼在地供應鏈，強化 AI 帶動的在地化趨勢。
國際私銀持續搶攻台灣 8 兆美元財管市場，金管會則為 2026 接軌新制優化壽險揭露規範。

items.title_zh: 台股收漲 0.65% 至 45,224、台積電領軍、法人買超 320 億
items.title_en: TAIEX rebounds 0.65% to 45,224 as TSMC leads, institutions buy NT$32bn
items.summary_zh: 加權指數開低走高、收漲 0.65% 至 45,224.29 點站回季線，台積電偕航運、金融助攻，逆勢消化美股疲弱。三大法人合計買超 320.5 億元，其中外資買超 276.1 億元，顯示在殖利率走高之際，市場對 AI 權值股的逢低承接力道仍穩健，盤面情緒回溫。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark opened lower but closed up 0.65% at 45,224.29, reclaiming its quarterly moving average, as TSMC, shipping and financials offset a soft US session. The three major institutional investors net-bought NT$32.05 billion, with foreign investors alone adding NT$27.61 billion — a sign that dip-buying appetite in the AI-heavy market remained firm despite rising global yields.

items.title_zh: 供應商估值翻身、日月光喊加碼在地供應鏈
items.title_en: Chip suppliers' valuations "come of age" as ASE talks up local sourcing
items.summary_zh: 在被形容為 30 年首見的半導體榮景下，供應鏈廠商估值明顯翻揚，封測龍頭日月光更喊出加碼在地供應鏈以強化韌性。此題材使市場領漲族群由晶圓代工龍頭外溢至材料與後段封測廠，反映 AI 資本支出循環正帶動更廣泛的零組件族群受惠。
items.summary_en: Amid a semiconductor boom described as the strongest in three decades, component suppliers are seeing a valuation re-rating, and packaging leader ASE said it will add more in-region suppliers to bolster resilience. The theme broadened market leadership beyond foundry giants toward materials and back-end names riding the AI capex wave.

items.title_zh: 台日高峰論壇力推「民主」半導體供應鏈
items.title_en: Taiwan–Japan summit pushes "democratic" semiconductor supply chain
items.summary_zh: 經濟部委辦的 2026 台日科技高峰論壇於台北登場，官方與業界以「民主供應鏈」為框架，深化台日在半導體、AI 與量子科技的合作，結合台灣晶圓製造與先進封裝優勢及日本在材料、精密設備與量子研究的深厚積累。合作意在於地緣政治與出口管制下強化供應鏈韌性。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Taiwan-Japan Tech Summit in Taipei, officials and industry framed deeper cooperation on chips, AI and quantum technology around a "democratic" supply chain, pairing Taiwan's lead in wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging with Japan's strengths in materials, precision equipment and quantum research. The tie-up aims to harden supply-chain resilience amid geopolitics and export controls.

items.title_zh: 路博邁點名五大關鍵科技、AI 為台鏈大變現
items.title_en: Neuberger Berman flags five key techs as AI "cashes in" for Taiwan's chain
items.summary_zh: 資產管理業者路博邁指出，2026 下半年是台灣 AI 供應鏈的收穫期，並點名五大關鍵科技將驅動獲利成長。此觀點強化市場對 AI 變現效應由運算晶片外溢至更廣泛台廠硬體與零組件族群的預期，帶動產業展望轉趨樂觀。
items.summary_en: Asset manager Neuberger Berman said the second half of 2026 marks a harvest period for Taiwan's AI supply chain, naming five key technologies set to drive earnings. The house view reinforced expectations that AI monetisation is spreading from compute into a wider set of Taiwanese hardware and component makers.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告修正保險業財報編製準則
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces revised insurer financial-reporting rules
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告修正「保險業財務報告編製準則」，優化財報表達、使資訊揭露更具透明與可比較性。此舉為壽險業 2026 年接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS）與 IFRS 17 鋪路，促使保險公司提升資產負債表揭露品質，牽動整體金融業體質與後續監理節奏。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission pre-announced amendments to the preparation standards for insurers' financial reports, aiming to improve presentation and make disclosures more transparent and comparable. The move is part of the groundwork for the industry's 2026 transition to the new solvency (TIS) and IFRS 17 regimes, nudging insurers toward cleaner balance-sheet reporting.

items.title_zh: 11 家保險業務金控獲准延至 15 日公布獲利
items.title_en: Eleven insurance-holding firms get an extra five days to report profits
items.summary_zh: 主管機關同意 11 家具保險業務的金控自 2026 年起，將每月獲利揭露期限由原本每月 10 日前延後至 15 日前，屬接軌會計與清償能力新制期間給予的監理彈性之一。此過渡措施可紓解業者在接軌壓力沉重之年的申報負擔，讓資源集中於制度轉換。
items.summary_en: Regulators are letting 11 financial holding companies with insurance operations defer their monthly earnings disclosure from the 10th to the 15th of each month in 2026, part of the transitional flexibility granted as the sector moves to the new accounting and solvency framework. The relief eases reporting strain during a demanding transition year.

items.title_zh: 瑞銀、滙豐搶攻台灣 8 兆美元財管市場
items.title_en: UBS, HSBC and rivals race for Taiwan's US$8tn wealth market
items.summary_zh: 包括瑞銀、滙豐在內的國際大型銀行加大力度，搶攻台灣快速成長的 8 兆美元財富管理市場，並推出多元金融資產擔保融資機制，以「資產池」概念綜合評估客戶整體金融資產價值、流動性與集中度。此布局反映各行競逐高資產客群、以整合式跨境服務深化財管關係的態勢。
items.summary_en: Global banks including UBS and HSBC are stepping up efforts to capture Taiwan's fast-growing US$8 trillion wealth-management market, rolling out multi-asset collateralised lending that pools clients' overall financial assets to assess value, liquidity and concentration. The push reflects intensifying competition to serve high-net-worth clients with integrated, cross-border services.

items.title_zh: 中國信託 × BCG 描繪台灣超高資產客群輪廓
items.title_en: CTBC–BCG study maps Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth clients
items.summary_zh: 中國信託與 BCG 發布的台灣超高資產財富洞察報告指出，財富傳承已從單純資產移轉轉向家族治理與價值延續，銀行藉家族溝通平台與不特定受益人信託協助跨世代建立共識。報告並指台灣高資產客戶仍缺乏私募股權、私募債權與避險基金等另類商品，與全球約四分之一資產屬另類資產的比重存在落差。
items.summary_en: A CTBC–BCG report on Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth segment highlights that succession is shifting beyond asset transfer toward family governance and value continuity, with banks building family-communication platforms and discretionary trust structures. It also notes local demand still lacks alternatives — private equity, private credit and hedge funds — a gap versus the roughly one-quarter of global AUM held in alternative assets.
